card.name: The word amount after a modifier
card.fires_on: The word "amount" (or "amounts") right after an adjective such as maximum, total, correct, recommended or least. It shows up in dosing and administration text, and also in general text.

modes.label: Amount of a drug or agent
modes.description: "amount" follows a dosing adjective and is about to be followed by "of" plus a substance.

modes.label: Amount in other settings
modes.description: "amount" follows a modifier in instructions or general explanations.
modes.example: the total<< amount>> of work done (Force x distance)

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on the word "amount" when it follows words like maximum, total or recommended.
